command.itemsstack.help.title: Items Stack commands:
command.itemsstack.help.set: /itemsstack set <item|#tag> <count> - Set or replace a stack size rule.
command.itemsstack.help.remove: /itemsstack remove <item|#tag> - Remove that exact item or tag rule.
command.itemsstack.help.reset: /itemsstack reset <item|#tag> - Force that item or tag back to its default stack size.
command.itemsstack.help.clear: /itemsstack clear - Remove all stack size rules.
command.itemsstack.help.reload: /itemsstack reload - Discard unsaved changes and reload the config from disk.
command.itemsstack.help.save: /itemsstack save - Save the current config to disk.
command.itemsstack.help.list: /itemsstack list [page] or /itemsstack list <items|tags> [page] - List configured rules.
command.itemsstack.help.list_page_size: /itemsstack list size [count] - Show or set how many rules are displayed per page for this session.
command.itemsstack.reset.success: Reset %s to its default stack size, affecting %d item(s)
command.itemsstack.reload.success: Reloaded %d stack size rule(s) from disk
command.itemsstack.save.success: Saved %d stack size rule(s) to disk
command.itemsstack.list.size.current: Rules per page is currently set to: %d
command.itemsstack.list.empty: No %s stack size rules are configured
command.itemsstack.list.invalid_page: Page %d does not exist. Last page is %d
text.config.items-stack-size-config.opti:
Use item=count or #tag=count. Exact item rules always override tag rules.
Among rules of the same type, later rules override earlier ones.
Changes are applied immediately; use /itemsstack save to save them to disk.
